jobs.title: Environmental Technician 1
jobs.description:
Company Description
SoilandWater.com Trust, LLC, is an ecological restoration consortium company headquartered near Bloomington, IN. We serve various units of government, and support landowners, communities, and partners in restoring land, water, and wildlife habitat. We offer practical solutions, environmental stewardship, and experience driven strategies. We work closely with clients to assess site conditions, develop the most feasible solutions to implement and get the job done. We also offer post project monitoring and reporting where necessary.

SoilandWater.com Trust LLC, provides "state of the science" solutions to environmental problems. A lot people can identify problems. Some can quantify problems. But real problem solvers are a rare and endangered species. And that is what we are...Problem SOLVERS.

Role Description
The Environmental Technician 1 is a most/full-time (10 months of the year) March through December, on-site position based near Bloomington, IN, but you must be flexible to travel.
The following basic life skills are mandatory:
Total honesty. Liars get fired promptly. We have to trust each other.
Ability to get your ass out of bed and to work on time
Not afraid of some hard work. Gamers don't fit in well. hard work still has never hurt anyone.
Willingness to work in all weather condition (that said, we do avoid working in temps below 15 degrees)
Dedication to see every task and project through completion.
Every project and every day has challenges and unforeseen issues to overcome. You are required to be an overcomer. Excuses do not advance the project. Resourcefulness and creative thinking, and persistence do.
A clean driving record. Addicts will never make it here.
If baby momma won't let you travel, this may pose a problem.
By ENDURANCE we conquer. And its not that hard.

Qualifications

Candidates should possess skills in environmental SCIENCE, engineering ,
Candidates should possess strong communication skills to document
Candidates should have mechanical aptitude and equipment operation skills.
Candidates should possess familiarity with surface water quality enhancement, wildlife habitat enhancement, lake and pond and stream restoration,
Relevant education such as an associate’s or bachelor of science degree in environmental science, or a related field, or equivalent field experience, is preferred but not required.
Valid driver’s license and ability to travel locally to project sites as needed.

jobs.title: Manager, Environmental Health & Safety, L'Oreal Research & Innovation
jobs.description:
Manager, Environmental Health & Safety (EHS), L'Oréal Research & Innovation – Clark, New Jersey

Life is too short for a boring career, so build an extraordinary one with us. We believe your career should spark the same thrill and curiosity as your personal interests. Creativity drives everything we do, turning ideas into meaningful impact. With opportunities across brands, markets, and divisions, your growth knows no boundaries.

Who We Are

Join us at L’Oréal, the world's #1 beauty company present in over 150 markets. For over a century, we have been transforming; fueled by data, tech, innovation, and science. Together, we tackle big challenges while making sure we stay committed to making the world a more inclusive and a better place for everyone & our planet.

At L’Oréal Research & Innovation (R&I), we are pushing the boundaries of Science & Tech. Our 3,500 R&I experts leverage Science & Technology to invent safe, trustable, and sustainable beauty experiences. We are seeking to add an EHS professional who, under minimal supervision, is responsible for the development, implementation and evaluation of all EHS programs within Research and Innovation as well as compliance with L’Oréal standards/policies, local, federal and state regulations.

A Day in the Life:
As the Manager of EHS, you are the guardian of our people and our planet. Your responsibilities include:

Accountable and responsible for the development, implementation and evaluation of all Environmental, Health & Safety programs for US R&I locations.

Manage EHS KPI’s and analyze trends
Provides supplemental EHS training to R&I employees.
Develops trainings, policies and procedures governing EHS compliance.
Leads and / or participates in EHS compliance assessments.
Manage EHS Committees and Emergency Response Teams.
Investigates and manage workplace incidents, near misses and helps ensure that corrective and preventive actions are implemented.
Evaluates potential employee exposure to hazardous conditions.
Monitor compliance with current policies and update when necessary
Work with departments to implement their EHS programs
Manage L’Oréal internal behavior-based safety programs: SIO/MESUR program
Manage Contractor management program
Teams with HR to manage Workmen’s Compensation cases.
Manage OSHA logs
Manage Validation and Inspection programs
Manage 5S program
Maintain Global EHS partnership within other divisions of L’Oréal
Interface with local, state and federal agencies
Some travel required (

We Are Looking For:
You are a visionary SEHS leader and a diplomatic influencer who thrives on resolving complex objectives through collaborative partnership.

Education: Bachelor’s degree in Occupational Safety, Environmental Science, or a related field is required (Master’s preferred). A professional certification in one or more of the following: Certified Industrial Hygienist (CIH) (preferred), Certified Safety Professional (CSP) (preferred), Certified Hazardous Materials Manager (CHMM), Certified Professional Environmental Auditor (CPEA) or Qualified Environmental Professional (QEP) is preferred
Experience:
Minimum of 5-7 years of professional EHS experience within a manufacturing or R&D setting.
Proven expertise in OSHA, EPA, and NFPA standards.
Prior hands-on work experience supporting EHS compliance.
Prior experience supporting EHS in cosmetics or pharmaceutical research laboratories (preferred but not required).
Excellent interpersonal, communication (written/oral), and organizational skills required.
Advanced computer skills including Microsoft Word, PowerPoint, Excel and SharePoint.
Must be able to work effectively in a matrix organization that provides services to multiple business partners.

Mandatory Requirements:
Ability to be onsite daily as an essential function of the position.
Availability for domestic and international travel (up to 15%).
Authorization to work in the U.S. on a permanent, ongoing basis. No immigration support/sponsorship offered for this role

What’s In It For You

A place for you to leave your comfort zone and grow beyond your potential (here, you’ll be encouraged to try new things and take risks!)
Real responsibility from day 1, there’s no sitting on the sidelines at L’Oréal
An environment where people of every ethnicity, social background, age, religion, gender and sexual orientation as well as people with disabilities are accepted, can speak up, will thrive and are celebrated!
A place where you can contribute to something bigger! Many of our brands have societal /environmental causes to make concrete difference
Competitive Benefits Package (Medical, Dental, Vision, 401K, Pension Plan)
Base Salary Range: $90,200 - $128,500 (The actual compensation will depend on a variety of job-related factors which may include geographic location, work experience, education, and skill level)
Flexible Time Off (Paid Company Holidays, Paid Vacation, Vacation Buy Program, Volunteer Time, Summer Fridays & More!)
Access to Company Perks (VIP Access to L’Oréal’s Internal Shop for Discounted Products, Monthly Mobile Allowance)
Learning and Development Opportunities (Unlimited Access to E-learnings, Lunch & Learn Sessions, Mentorship Programs, & More!)
Employee Resource Groups (Think Tanks and Innovation Squads)
Access to Mental Health & Wellness Programs

Don’t meet every single requirement?
At L'Oréal, we are dedicated to building a diverse, inclusive, and innovative workplace. If you’re excited about this role but your past experience doesn’t align perfectly with the qualifications listed in the job description, we encourage you to apply anyways! You may just be the right candidate for this or other roles!

We are an Equal Opportunity Employer
and take pride in a diverse environment. We’re committed to guaranteeing inclusive recruitment processes and advocating for hiring and promoting each candidate in an ethical and equitable way. The Group strictly prohibits discrimination against any applicant for employment because of the individual’s gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, visible and/or invisible disabilities, socio-economic and/or multicultural origins, health conditions, age, religion, or any other characteristics protected by law.

Show more

Show less

Seniority level

Not Applicable

Employment type

Full-time

Industries

Manufacturing and Personal Care Product Manufacturing
